name: mirage
text: Yes, and that part is already in the fix I'm shipping: the engine's order ledger (every bet, bid fill and live buy, with the player, team and prop) is carried from each engine run to the next, and the live lane, auto-bet and bids all read it before ordering, so a restart no longer gives anything back. The one gap I know of is an order placed in the last few seconds before a hard cancel, before the ledger was saved; I'll also make the engine read Novig's own open positions (which include your hand bets and bids that filled) so even that and anything placed outside the engine counts. I'm adding that to the plan.
